title: FTpa
description: Add tpa and relevant command for Minecraft.
body:
FTpa can only load on server. It added some command for players.
This mod is just used to filling in the gap of Minecraft 1.21.11 fabric.

|Commands|Function|
|--------|--------|
|/tpa <Player>|Send teleport request to target player|
|/tpahere <Player>|Invite target player teleport to you|
|/tpaccept|Accept telepport request from others|
|/tpadent|Reject teleport request from others|
|/tpacancel|Cancel the request that you send to others|

If the mod version >= 0.2, you can change all tpa message in the config file.
